verdict.rationale: MoonPay's SDK/API surface (quotes, connect, payment methods, buy/sell frames, auth, challenge flows) mirrors most of the on-ramp/off-ramp UI functionality, letting developers build fully headless flows ('Your UI, your flow, our rails') — a strong case of API parity for core buy/sell operations. However, the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard endpoints (404s), and a community comment questions whether the full API/webhook set is public, suggesting the developer-facing API may not expose every capability (e.g., account/back-office management, full KYC controls) that the hosted UI provides. Missing for 10: publicly verifiable complete API spec, evidence of parity for account/KYC management and admin features, and independent confirmation that all UI-only actions are also API-accessible.
